title: Improving Steam System Performance: A Sourcebook for Industry, Second Edition — Figure 1 Steam System Schematic; Figures 2 and 3 Firetube/Watertube Boiler
description: Whole-steam-system schematic (generation, distribution, end use, condensate return) plus cutaway schematics of firetube and watertube boilers; accompanying text identifies fuel supply, combustion air, feedwater system, deaerator, feedwater pump, blowdown and exhaust gas venting as the generation subsystems.
